children: Introducing the Weekly Edge Case. Each week, this article format turns the spotlight on a single company surfaced by Market Edge. The aim is simple: to show the framework consisting of Quality Rating in combination with Value and Momentum, at work on one concrete name. The first Weekly Edge Case starts at the top. Of the entire coverage universe, exactly one company currently screens a perfect 5 on both Market Edge scores – Cheap on Value and Very Strong on Momentum. A fitting place to begin.

This is a press release from Redeye Nordic Growth AB, a equity research firm specializing in Nordic growth companies within Tech and Life Science. Redeye Nordic Growth is a part of the Redeye group, which also offers services within corporate finance advisory and fund management. https://services.redeye.se/

title: Weekly Edge Case: Surgical Science
